raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Bumps the github-actions group with 1 update: [pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish](https://github.com/pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish). Updates `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` from 1.14.2 to 1.14.3
Release notes

Sourced from pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish's releases.

v1.14.3

[!important] 🚨 This release includes fixes for GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 patched up by @​sethmlarson💰 in #427 and in other places across the ecosystem.

Additional ecosystem and related mitigations beyond you might want to watch out for:

  • https://discuss.python.org/t/information-for-python-users-regarding-emudhra-emsign-ca-certificate-security-incident/109576
  • https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com

🛠️ Security Tightening

@​webknjaz💰 made sure the dependency tree within the action runtime uses hash-checking from now on via pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish#420.

🪞 Full Diff: https://github.com/pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish/compare/v1.14.2...v1.14.3

🧔‍♂️ Release Manager: @​webknjaz 🇺🇦

💬 Discuss on Bluesky 🦋, on Mastodon 🐘 and on GitHub.

Commits
  • 7245906 Merge pull request #427 from sethmlarson/certifi-sigstore
  • 331eccb Upgrade certifi and sigstore
  • f68fee4 💰 Sync the FUNDING config
  • c0d6f8e Merge branch 'integrity/runtime/deptree' into unstable/v1
  • 9090099 🧪 Make smoke test deps hash-pinned in CI
  • 34e40c2 📌 Bump pip-tools managed transitive deptrees
  • e800ed5 👷 Enable hash-checking in the runtime deptree 🔗
  • dd8c5f4 🔧 Make pip-tools config available in container
  • See full diff in compare view
